title: Yara and the Autopsy
author: Emrys Ishikawa
blurb: Casper Coldharbour, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
